subject.title: Feature request: config option to suppress sub-agent announce

question: Which public sub-agent completion-announcement control should OpenClaw support for deterministic suppression: per-spawn only, config default, or a unified announce policy that can later compose with routing and per-channel work?
rationale: The source gap is real, but repository policy treats new config/default/tool API surfaces as compatibility-sensitive and the issue overlaps several open routing and channel-granularity requests.

options.title: Adopt a unified announce policy
options.body: Add an additive policy that defaults to current behavior, supports deterministic skip, and leaves room for parent/per-channel routing without parallel controls.

options.title: Add per-spawn skip only
options.body: Expose the smallest `sessions_spawn` override first and defer global/per-channel defaults until the broader routing design is selected.

options.title: Defer to routing design
options.body: Keep this issue open but wait for the broader `announceTarget` and per-channel suppression decisions before adding any public surface.

recommendation.title: Adopt a unified announce policy
recommendation.body: Add an additive policy that defaults to current behavior, supports deterministic skip, and leaves room for parent/per-channel routing without parallel controls.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest feature-history signal for the spawn/announce public API and config compatibility decision.
